text:
For an **iPhone 17**, look for **Qi2.2 (25W)**. The iPhone 17 can charge wirelessly at 25W, while older Qi2 banks top out at 15W. Below are the slimmest good options from the search results, split by capacity.

## Best slim 10,000 mAh with 25W Qi2.2: INIU SnapGo Air
- **0.5 in thick, 195 g**, 10,000 mAh, **25W Qi2.2** wireless, 45W USB-C out
- Comes with a 60W braided USB-C cable that clips on like a lanyard, plus an LED display
- Macworld rates it "equal slimmest 10K" MagSafe bank. Its main downside is no kickstand.
- Price: about **$42.99–$48.99 on Amazon** or $44.99 at INIU (list $54.99)
- Buy links: in [Android Central's roundup](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge) and [Macworld's guide](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html). My results didn't include a direct product URL.

**Similar alternatives:**
- **Ugreen MagFlow Pro 10K:** equally slim, 25W wireless and 45W wired. It had the best battery-capacity score in Macworld's tests. See the [Macworld guide](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html).
- **Kuxiu S4:** equally slim, 25W wireless, semi-solid-state battery, and a kickstand. Same [Macworld guide](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html).
- **Baseus PicoGo AM52:** 10K, 25W Qi2.2, 45W wired. It's $59.99 at Baseus, or **$53.99 with code AM52**, which the deal site says worked in Baseus's cart on Oct 24. My results didn't list its thickness. The link goes through an affiliate redirect, so the site earns a commission: [dealectric.com/go/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w) ([details](https://dealectric.com/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w)).

## Best ultra-slim 5,000 mAh: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim)
- **0.34 in (8.6 mm), 122 g**, Qi2 **15W** wireless, 20W USB-C two-way
- 9to5Mac calls it the closest thing to Apple's MagSafe battery, with a premium feel and cooler running.
- **$54.99** at Anker, with $5 off via an auto-applied code. Buy: [anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)
- Expect roughly 60–75% of a recharge on an iPhone.

**Alternative:** the **ReelCharge ReelSafe** is 0.35 in, 119 g, 15W, has a semi-solid-state battery, and costs $49.99 ([Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)).

## Skip for an iPhone 17
- **Baseus PicoGo Air AM71:** it's the thinnest at 0.27 in and 104 g, but it only charges wirelessly at **7.5W** because it isn't Qi2.
- **Apple MagSafe Battery ($99):** it's designed for the iPhone Air and charges at only 12W ([9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/)).

**My pick:** the **INIU SnapGo Air** if you want a full recharge or more at 25W, or the **Anker Nano 5K Slim** if being thin matters most. Prices change, so check the final price at checkout.
